title: Decoding an encoded matrix
statement: Let $R$ be a list of rows of natural numbers. Encode each entry by its binary bit list, encode each row by concatenating the pair encodings of its entry bit lists with empty second components, and encode the matrix by concatenating the pair encodings of these row encodings with empty second components. Decoding this matrix encoding yields the list of encoded rows.
hypotheses_covered: $R$ is a list of lists of natural numbers
